scope: Independent read-only source semantics and complete28-file effective PR/packet review. No builds, microprobes, VM, private oracle/sweep imports/execution or source/remote mutations.
semantic_assessment: No source correctness defect identified in the two new immediate-use pointer reloads. No source repair is required by this review; measured admission remains build/root responsibility.

source_sites.operation: Volatile-load Box<Account<BondingCurve>> pointer storage as a Copy shared &Account<BondingCurve>, then copy creator.
basis: AdminCto.bonding_curve is a Box<Account<...>> with default Global allocator and a Sized referent; pinned SDK Box documentation guarantees single-pointer C-compatible representation.
The pointer comes from &a.bonding_curve, the live, aligned initialized Box field itself; there is no guessed private Anchor Account field offset.
The loaded T is &Account<...> (Copy), not Box or Account. No owner/destructor is duplicated; .creator uses normal Anchor Deref and copies a Pubkey.
No move, replacement or mutable borrow of this Box occurs between pointer load and immediate creator copy. No loaded reference is stored or used across later mutation.

source_sites.operation: Transmute the outer &&mut AdminCto reference value to *const &AdminCto, then volatile-load a Copy shared reference for immediate pool.owner comparison.
basis: Pinned Anchor0.31.1 Context.accounts is &mut T, and the preceding let a=&ctx.accounts points directly at that initialized reference slot. No Context representation or field-offset assumption is introduced.
The transmute preserves a pointer value and its provenance without integer conversion. Reading the initialized inner &mut T slot as a shared &T creates no copied mutable reference.
AdminCto is Sized; the slot and pointee remain aligned, live and initialized. The temporary shared reference is consumed in one condition and is not retained across mutation or CPI.
The earlier mutable curve borrow is in a completed lexical block before let a is rebound. This site introduces no overlapping live mutable use.

control_flow_boundaries: validate errors still return before the shared-arm pointer read.
shared=false and shared=true/holder=true paths do not execute the Box-pointer reload; shared=true/holder=false copies the same existing creator.
The pool data-empty condition remains the left operand of &&, so empty pools skip the new accounts-pointer read and produce false.
For nonempty pools the same pool.owner==AMM comparison decides the branch; neither owner policy nor error/event behavior is strengthened or weakened.
Neither new site writes a pointer slot, changes ownership/reference counts, copies an &mut or Box owner, or adds an assume/unreachable/branch hint.
assumptions_and_limits: This reasoning uses the existing valid typed Anchor Context and Box/reference invariants; volatile is not a synchronization primitive or a permission to race with writes.
Box uniqueness/raw-pointer guidance requires no use after mutation/move/reborrow; the immediate-use scopes satisfy that restriction here.
No claim of formal semantic equivalence, whole-ELF identity, compiler output or runtime acceptance is made. Fresh composed-source build/score with no losses and VM receipts are independent gates.
Optional same-line SAFETY comments could document why Copy shared references are loaded; new representation probes are not required for the guaranteed Sized/default-Global Box layout.
